facts.claim: 尖鼻白蚁属是新热带鼻白蚁亚科唯一无大型兵蚁的属；克拉丽塔尖鼻白蚁据小型兵蚁与有翅若虫描述，采于哥伦比亚亚马孙次生雨林。
facts.quote: Acorhinotermes Emerson, 1949 is the only Neotropical Rhinotermitine genus with no major soldier. Herein Acorhinotermes claritae Castro & Scheffrahn, sp. nov. is described based on minor soldiers and an alate nymph collected in a secondary rain forest in the Colombian Amazon.
